result.instructions: Tools for Swoogo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which events do we have coming up, and what are their dates?"; "How many confirmed registrants does our spring conference have?"; "List the speakers and sessions for the keynote track.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Swoogo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run swoogo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run swoogo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run swoogo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. swoogo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: swoogo_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events in the Swoogo account with dates, timezone, status and registration URL. Start here to find an event_id. Swoogo API: GET /events.

search.description: Filter, for example registration_status=confirmed or created_at>=2024-01-01. Join conditions with & (AND).

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending, for example -created_at.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, for example id,name,start_date.

tools.name: swoogo_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one event by id, with its full settings: name, dates, timezone, capacity, status and registration URL. Swoogo API: GET /events/{event_id}.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, for example id,name,start_date.
